name: A-Force
deck: In Battleworld, they were the greatest defenders of Arcadia. In the Marvel Universe, they are assembled by Singularity to fight together.

name: A-Next
deck: A-Next is the MC2 Universe version of the Avengers and consists of the sons, daughters, and proteges of the previous generation of heroes.

name: A.I.M.
deck: An organization of brilliant scientists and their hirelings dedicated to the acquisition of power and the overthrow of all governments by technological means.

name: Aakon
deck: An alien race and enemies of The Kree.

name: Agents of Atlas
deck: A superhero team formed by the Government in 1958 and brought back together by their leader Jimmy Woo nearly 40 years later, the Agents of Atlas are a team of misfits dedicated to using the resources of an evil empire to bring about good.

name: Agents of Wakanda
deck: A staff of experts and field agents to assess risks and threats before the Avengers get involved.

name: All-Winners Squad
deck: The All-Winners Squad was the first team published in a comic book by Timely Comics (who later became Marvel Comics).

name: Alpha Centaurians
deck: A race of humanoid aliens native to Alpha Centauri. Of the three habitable planets around the star, two separate races exist. One is aquatic and the other is a land based marsupial.

name: Alpha Flight
deck: Alpha Flight is Canada's premiere superhero team. Amongst its members are Guardian, Sasquatch, Puck, Vindicator, and Northstar. Even Wolverine has been counted among their ranks.

name: Anachronauts
deck: The Anachronauts are the greatest warriors of their time periods, gathered by Kang to protect his citadel in Chronopolis.

name: Annihilation Wave
deck: The Annihilation Wave are an army from the Negative Zone.

name: Ant-Man & Wasp
deck: The Pym's have been presented together as couple throughout a substantial portion of their publication history together.

name: Ant-Man's Ants
deck: Hank Pym created a cybernetic helmet which would enable him to communicate with ants by transmitting and receiving psionic/electrical waves. Through this helmet, he managed to control a number of ants who would help him in his adventures as Ant-Man.

name: Asgardian Gods
deck: The deities of Norse mythology.

name: Ashen Combine
deck: A collection of the Multiverse's greatest monsters who cause destruction simply for their own sick appetite.

name: Astrans
deck: Astrans are a race of aliens from the planet Astra located in the Mu Cephi star system.

name: Atlanteans
deck: A water breathing species known as Homo Mermani who occupied sunken Atlantis and built an undersea empire in the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Attilan Royal Family
deck: The Attilan Royal Family are nobility of the Inhuman people with many of their leaders descended from this bloodline.

name: Avatars of Templar
deck: Six forms of Lord Templar that he is able to released which act independently, each with a different ability.

name: Avengers
deck: The Avengers are Earth's mightiest heroes and foremost super-team... "There came a day, a day unlike any other, when Earth's mightiest heroes found themselves united against a common threat. On that day, the Avengers were born - to fight the foes no single super hero could withstand! Heed the call, then - for now, the Avengers Assemble!"

name: Avengers 1,000,000 BC
deck: This is the earliest historical version of a team like The Avengers, consisting of the bearers of the Marvel Universe's oldest mantles. They first banded together during the Stone Age to stop a Celestial from destroying the Earth.

name: Avengers Academy
deck: The Avengers Academy is a program where veteran heroes help train young people with dangerous super-powers and damaged psyches to become valuable heroes.

name: Avengers Infinity
deck: Avengers Infinity was the name attributed to a small band of Avengers stationed in Space.

name: Avengers Unity Squad
deck: A superhero team comprised of both Avengers and X-Men that was formed by Captain America with a goal to show the world that humans and mutants can work together.

name: Avengers West Coast
deck: The West Coast Avengers are a team that branched off from the Avengers and settles in California in order to respond to threats on the West Coast in a more timely manner.

name: Axi-Tun
deck: An alien humanoid race that appear like tall humans about 6'4" from the planet Tun

name: Badoon
deck: A reptilian species divided by gender.

name: Baintronics
deck: A rival company to Stark Industries owned by Sunset Bain (Madame Menace).

name: Battleworld Avengers
deck: A group of teens who are the children of the heroes who remained on Battleworld, after the death of Reed Richards. They banded together as the Battleworld Avengers.

name: Beyonders
deck: The Beyonders are a mysterious omnipotent race from another plane of existence, for whom the Marvel multiverse is simply a lab for them to conduct experiments upon.

name: Black Novas
deck: When a rogue member of the Nova Corps unlocked the full potential of the Nova Force without having to become a Centurion, he created a new branch of Black Novas designed to be vigilantes. When Jesse Alexander joined the team, he had all corrupt members arrested and turned the team into a black ops unit.

name: Black Order
deck: The deadly generals dispatched by Thanos to bring the Earth to its knees.

name: Bloodcoven
deck: Bloodstorm One, a Hydra-created clone of Dracula, leads the Bloodcoven, a secretive and dangerous vampire faction. Their extreme brutality and unwavering devotion to a dark master only match their bloodlust.

name: Brand Corporation
deck: A criminal organization that is run like a business

name: Brood
deck: The Brood are a race of alien parasites that reproduce by implanting their eggs in others. They are a recurring enemy of the X-Men, Sh'iar, Carol Danvers and others in the Marvel Universe.

name: Brotherhood of Evil Mutants
deck: Brotherhood of Evil Mutants has been the name of several mutant supervillain groups.

name: Builders
deck: Created and founded by Captain Universe countless millennia ago, the Builders are one of the oldest and most powerful civilizations in the universe and have recently become one of the greatest threats the universe has ever known.

name: Cabal
deck: The Cabal is a secret group of criminal masterminds originally assembled by Loki in Acts of Vengeance. Subsequent iterations have been brought together by Red Skull, Norman Osborn during Dark Reign and Namor after Infinity.

name: Cadre K
deck: A team of Skrull mutants taught by Professor X.

name: Cape Killers
deck: A government anti-superhero task force, staffed with superhuman parolees

name: Cavemen
deck: "Cavemen" is an obsolete term for ancient humans (and sometimes other hominids) who allegedly lived in caves, now existing almost entirely as a genre artifact and/or a romanticized or poetic term.

name: Celestials
deck: A giant and ancient cosmic race that used their godlike abilities to experiment on lower life forms. They are responsible for mankind's potential to gain superhuman powers as well as the creation of various races and life forms in the universe, the most know being the race of Godlike beings know as the Eternals and Deviants, the opposite of the Eternals.

name: Champions
deck: Originally a superhero team based in Los Angeles that was meant to serve the interests of the common person on the West Coast because the East Coast already had several teams. Years later, a new version with young heroes assembled.

name: Children of Thanos
deck: Thanos' personal horde of outcasts and criminals he has collected from across the galaxy to serve him. They are commonly referred to as "Thanos-Thralls" but appointed the name "Children of Thanos" for themselves following the demise of their leader.

name: Circus of Crime
deck: The Circus of Crime is a traveling band of circus performers who use their abilities to rob their audience.

name: Cloak and Dagger
deck: A team of two misunderstood runaways who first became friends and, later, heroes.

name: Commission on Superhuman Activities
deck: A US Government agency that regulates activity and legislation of paranormals and costumed adventurers. More often than not they are seen as hindrance and antagonists to the likes of the X-Men, Captain America and the Thunderbolts.

name: Communists
deck: The most influential ideology of the 20th Century, communism shaped the world into two opposing super-powers. In many ways the Communists replaced Nazis as a real life foe for superheroes in the post-WWII world.

name: Convocation of Wizards
deck: A League of Evil Sorcerers

name: Cotati
deck: The Cotati are an intelligent alien race that resembles large plants or trees.

name: Council of Kangs
deck: Initially The Council of Kangs was composed of a trio of Kangs from different realities to eliminate all other Kangs. After Kang destroyed his three counterparts, the Council of Kangs reformed - unbeknownst to him - made up of all divergent Kangs.

name: Council of Red
deck: A group of multiversal Mephistos

name: D'Bari
deck: Alien species who were all but wiped out when the Dark Phoenix destroyed their home-planet.

name: D.O.A.
deck: Hydra's occult section. The acronym stands for Department of Occult Armaments.

name: Daily Bugle
deck: A New York City tabloid newspaper organization located in New York. J. Jonah Jameson, a superhero aggravant, served both as the editor and publisher. Under his leadership it was known for its smear campaigns against superheroes, particularly Spider-Man. It was sold to Dexter Bennett after Jameson suffered a heart attack. It was renamed to the DB and was destroyed after a battle between Electro and Spider-Man.

name: Dark Avengers
deck: Originally an idea concocted by Norman Osborn, the "Dark Avengers" were Osborn's own personal counterpart to the Avengers. The team has since become independent from Osborn's visions and mad quest for power.

name: Dark Celestials
deck: The Final Host are a race of Dark Celestials responsible for killing the other Celestial hosts.

name: Dark Elves
deck: Dark Elves are a type of magic wielding Elf native to Svartalfheim, one of the Nine Realms. While not exclusively villainous, they are frequently the enemies of Thor and have an affinity for dark environments.

name: Dark X-Men
deck: Norman Osborn's own personal team of X-Men assembled during his dark reign.

name: Defenders
deck: The Defenders are a super-group in the Marvel Universe usually led by Doctor Strange. The team that wasn't a team, often fights against supernatural and magic-based opponents. Protecting humanity from the impossible!

name: Deviants
deck: The Deviants are an evolutionary offshoot of humanity created by the Celestials' experiments on prehistoric humans around a million years ago.

name: Dinosaurs
deck: The most diverse group of prehistoric reptiles that ruled the Earth many millions of years ago. Dinosaurs come in various shapes and sizes ranging from being smaller than a chicken to being bigger than the largest whales. Scientists have discovered thousands of different species that had dominated the world during the Mesozoic Era with their descendants, the birds still alive today.

name: Doom's Robot Army
deck: The army of robots Doom created to guard Latveria from external and internal enemies.

name: Doombots
deck: The Doombots are robots created by Doctor Doom. Usually used as a single robot to impersonate Doom but sometimes used in multiple numbers as armies for Doom.

name: Dora Milaje
deck: The Adored Ones are the Wakandan all-female personal body guards of the King/Queen. They are highly skilled in the use of various weapons and styles of martial art.

name: Dragons
deck: Dragons are prominently powerful creatures featured in many tales in the fantasy genre.

name: Dwarves
deck: Dwarves or Dwarfs is a fictional race from Germanic mythology.

name: Elements of Doom
deck: The Elements of Doom are a team consisting of living elements that have battled the Avengers and the Thunderbolts.

name: Eternals
deck: The Eternals are an evolutionary offshoot of humanity living on Earth who possess greater powers and longer lifespans than the mainstream human race.

name: Ex Nihili
deck: One of the Builder races, the Ex Nihili are gardeners, charged with seeding a world with new life after an Aleph has razed it to the ground.

name: Excalibur
deck: A superteam organized by Professor Xavier and Magneto to rebuild the devastated mutant nation of Genosha. No connection to the British superhero team Excalibur.

name: Exemplars
deck: A group of villains given powers by extradimensional beings as part of a contest to see which was most powerful. The most famous of the Exemplars is none other than the Juggernaut.

name: Exiles
deck: A group of international would be world conquerers that were allies of the Red Skull who fought against such heroes as Captain America and his side-kick the Falcon, and later Dr. Doom. Their base of operations is the appropriately named Isle of Exiles.

name: Fall People
deck: The Fall people are allies of the X-Men in the Savage Land. A member of the tribe, Nereel, is the mother of Peter Rasputin's alleged son, Peter.

name: Fantastic Four
deck: An intrepid group of astronauts: Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm, and Ben Grimm originally received their powers after being exposed to an immense amount of cosmic radiation during a trip into space. Mutated and given strange powers by this exposure, they became the Fantastic Four and dedicated their abilities to the good of humanity.

name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
deck: United States federal criminal investigation and internal intelligence agency.

name: Fists of Khonshu
deck: A lineage of priests to Khonshu, the moon god of Egypt.

name: Five Lights
deck: Excluding Hope Summers, The Five Lights are the first five new mutants to emerge since Scarlet Witch's spell ceased all new mutations on M-Day. Each of the Lights successfully mutated after physical contact with Hope.

name: Flying Trolls
deck: Flying Trolls of Thryheim. They are lead by the Queen Ula.

name: Fomalhauti
deck: Alien race

name: Fomorians
deck: Also know as Fomor or Fomorians. The Fomorians are a semi-divine race opposed to the Celtic Gods.

name: Friends of Humanity
deck: The Friends of Humanity are an anti-mutant hate group formed by Graydon Creed.

name: Frightful Four
deck: Introduced as the nemesis to the Fantastic Four, the rotation has constantly changed but features the Wizard as its leader. Its current roster consists of the Wizard, Bulldozer (Marci Camp), Thunderball and Wrecker.

name: Frost Giants
deck: Giants that are at a constant state of war with the Asgardians. The giants have shown the ability to manipulate ice as projectiles, balls, spikes, and more. They are also vastly strong and durable. Each of the giants can range from 20 feet to 30 feet in height. Of all the races of giants, the foremost enemies of the Asgardians are the Frost Giants.

name: Future Foundation
deck: The Future Foundation was created by Mr. Fantastic to bring humanity into a greater future after his dissatisfaction with Earth's leading scientific community. It consisted of a new generation of student that would be taught by the Fantastic Four, their allies, and a revolving number of experts for a variety of fields.

name: Galactic Council
deck: The Galactic Council is the congregation of leaders from different alien species, planets and empires.

name: Goddesses of Thunder
deck: The granddaughters of Old King Thor

name: Gods of Olympus
deck: A group comprised of the immortal Gods, both major and minor, some demigods, some heroes and many monsters and creatures of the ancient Greek and Roman religions now commonly referred to as Greco-Roman Mythology.

name: Great Captains of Krakoa
deck: The war Captains or Great Captains of Krakoa is in charge of advancing the military interests of the mutant nation - Krakoa.

name: Great Ring of Arakko
deck: The Great Ring is the governing body of the lost mutant island of Arakko.

name: Grunds
deck: A race of small aliens from the planet Grundar.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
deck: The first published Guardians of the Galaxy was a team of freedom fighters in the 31st century. The name was later used for the team Star-Lord formed to deal with galactic-level threats in present day. The present day team's name was influenced by a member of the 31st century team who had time traveled to the present.

name: H.A.M.M.E.R.
deck: After the events of Secret Invasion, Norman Osborn disbanded S.H.I.E.L.D. and from the ashes, he founded H.A.M.M.E.R., a group built to cover Osborn's dirty schemes.

name: Hammer Industries
deck: A group of super-villians financed and outfitted by their employer, Justin Hammer.

name: Hammer Troopers
deck: Squadron of the Galactic Avengers that attacked the Centauri-VI.

name: Heroes For Hire
deck: Founded by Luke Cage and Iron Fist, Heroes for Hire is a superhero cornerstone referring to a group of superpowered mercenaries and bodyguards, who hire out their aid in exchange for money.

name: Horsemen of Apocalypse
deck: Superhumans of great power chosen by Apocalypse as his greatest followers. Genetically enhanced to be beyond what they were before, the Horsemen herald their master's terrible vision for the world.

name: House of Magnus
deck: Mutant royal family of Earth-58163.

name: Howling Commandos
deck: There has been three teams of Howling Commandos. The first was active in WWII and beyond, consisting of Nick Fury and others. The second one consisted mostly of supernaturals and monsters. The third one is a team consisting of black-ops specialists equipped with cutting-edge tech.

name: Hulkbusters
deck: The original Hulkbusters were a large military force, consisting of both United States Army and Air force personnel, whose mission was the capture or destruction of the menace known as the Hulk.

name: HYDRA
deck: A worldwide subversive organization dedicated to global domination. At its height, HYDRA was the most extensive, powerful, and dangerous organization in history.

name: Illuminati
deck: A clandestine organization composed of the world's most influential and important people that guides events in the Marvel Universe.

name: Imperial Guard
deck: The Imperial Guard is a legion of superpowered champions who protect and defend the Shi'ar galactic empire.

name: Inhumans
deck: The result of Kree experimentation on Homo Neanderthalensis using Terrigen Mist, The Inhumans are a race of super powered beings who live in isolation and do not trust humans.

name: Inner Guard
deck: A team of robots, serving Madame Masque.

name: Intelligencia
deck: Group consisting of the Earth's most evil geniuses in the Marvel Universe.

name: Intimidators
deck: The Minions of Menace were formed by Korvac to fight Thor and the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Invaders
deck: The greatest superheroes of their time joined together to fight the Axis powers during World War II. Those who have survived into the modern era continue to team up when needed.

name: Killraven's Freemen
deck: A group of freedom fighters against Martian oppression.

name: Knights of the Round Table
deck: King Arthur's knights.

name: Kosmosians
deck: A gigantic semi-reptilian alien race with size changing abilities.

name: Kree
deck: The Kree are a militant race with a vast empire.

name: Kree Public Accuser Corps
deck: Public Accusers are the pre-eminent law enforcement body of the Kree Empire with these legislators acting as judge, jury and executioner.

name: Kree Sentry
deck: The ultimate weapons of The Kree Army. Kree Sentry's are gigantic super powered androids only created and trained to destroy any who would oppose the ever-lasting Kree or those who guard its far-flung galactic empire.

name: Kree/Skrull Empire
deck: Kree-Skrull Alliance was created due to the remnants of the Kree Imperium and Skrull Empire uniting under Emperor Hulkling.

name: Krieger Sect
deck: The Warriors of Krieg Sect are one of the strongest sects of vampires. They are led by Legate.

name: Kronans
deck: The Kronans, also known as the Rock People from Saturn, are an alien race that Korg and Zardok belong too.

name: Kymellians
deck: The Kymellians are a species that bear a similar appearance to horses. They have long been enemies of the evil Z'nrx (Snarks), and lost their home planet long ago.

name: Lava Men
deck: An underground race known as the Gortokians transformed by a demon that have battled the Fantastic Four and the Avengers.

name: Legion of the Unliving
deck: The Legion Of The Unliving has had many incarnations over the years. The Legion members have often been dead heroes and villains and have primarily fought the Avengers. The current team are all vampires.

name: Lethal Legion
deck: A group of villains that has taken several forms over the years, each iteration equally dedicated to the destruction of the Avengers.

name: Los Angeles Police Department
deck: The Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) serves and protects the largest city in the State of California.

name: Lunatic Legion
deck: The Lunatic Legion is a name that has been taken by two groups of Kree.

name: Madame Masque's Bio-Duplicates
deck: Decoys used by Madame Masque. They have a short-life expectancy.

name: Maggia
deck: An international crime syndicate including three of New York's most prominent criminal families, the Silvermanes, the Hammerheads and the Nefarias.

name: Magnum Force
deck: Mercenaries working for Moses Magnum.

name: Magnum Munitions
deck: Magnum Munitions is a weapons company. The owner is the notorious Moses Magnum.

name: Makluans
deck: A race of gigantic dragon like aliens with from the planet Maklu-IV. They are thought to be responsible for the dragon myths in both ancient China and medieval England.

name: Mandroids
deck: A Stark Designed battle suit built for S.H.I.E.L.D. The plans for the Mark I and II have been known to fall into the wrong hands however and are used by villains as well as government agents.

name: Maria Stark Foundation
deck: An organization which funds the Avengers.

name: Martians
deck: Traditionally martians are small green humanoids.

name: Marvel Monsters
deck: From the mid to late 1950s through to the early 1960s, Marvel wasn't about men in tights. It was about MONSTERS!

name: Masters of Evil
deck: The Masters of Evil is the name of various groups of super villains and their motive is usually to defeat or humiliate the Avengers. Leaders have included both Baron Zemos, Ultron, the Mandarin, Klaw, Doctor Octopus, Egghead, the Crimson Cowl, Machinesmith, Whirlwind, the Hood, Jonas Harrow, Max Fury and Lightmaster.

name: Midnight Mission
deck: After being separated by Khonshu because the god betrayed the Avengers, Moon Knight started a new congregation in Manhattan, focusing on helping those who travel at night.

name: Midnight Wreckers
deck: Scavengers of the year 2020 AD and allies to Machine Man.

name: Mighty
deck: Avengers with Stark and Asgardian Tech.

name: Mighty Avengers
deck: A group of six individuals who banded together to stop the Deathwatchers from bringing about the end of humanity.

name: Mindless Ones
deck: A monstrous race of mindless slaves from the Dread Dimensions.

name: N'Garai
deck: The N'Garai are extra-dimensional demons who were created by Chthon after he fled from the 616 reality in order to escape Demogorge. They are prophesied to herald the coming of an apocalypse where demons will one day walk the earth.

name: Nazis
deck: This name represents not only those that lived during the time of the historical Third Reich, but also those who subscribed to its ideals after its fall.

name: Necro-Cyborgs
deck: Cybernetically reanimated corpses of the population of Slorenia utilized by Ultron to battle the Avengers, the U.S. Army and the U.N. Troops.

name: New Avengers
deck: After a massive breakout at the Raft super-villain prison, Earth's Mightiest Heroes united again to catch the inmates who escaped, some leave, some stay and some are new recruits which ultimately became the New Avengers.

name: New Men
deck: Animals transformed into humanoid beings by the High Evolutionary.

name: New Mutants
deck: The New Mutants are a team of young mutants in training at Xavier's School For Gifted Youngsters.

name: New Warriors
deck: A team of superpowered teens originally formed by Night Thrasher until they inadvertently started the Civil War. Ever since, they would go through multiple temporary incarnations but could never consistently stay together.

name: New York Fire Department
deck: The NYFD is tasked with protecting New York from fire and fire threats.

name: New York Police Department
deck: The police force of the New York City.

name: Next Avengers
deck: The children of the Avengers of a dark, twisted dystopian future where Ultron slew their parents and became the sovereign of Earth.

name: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
deck: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization or NATO is an European intergovernmental military alliance.

name: Nova Corps
deck: An intergalactic peacekeeping force.

name: Nugent Technologies
deck: Nugent Technologies, founded by Alice Nugent, specializes in telecommunications. Control of Nugent Technologies was usurped by Ultron.

name: Omega Flight
deck: Omega Flight is a Canadian superhero team and follow up to Alpha Flight.

name: Orchis
deck: Orchis is an organization dedicated to a response to a "Doomsday" scenario involved an extinction-level population of Homo superior. Formed from the ranks of S.H.I.E.L.D., S.T.R.I.K.E., S.W.O.R.D., A.R.M.O.R., A.I.M., Alpha Flight, H.A.M.M.E.R. and HYDRA,

name: Order
deck: The Order were the California state intiative super-team.

name: Outlaw Avengers
deck: Captain America's Resistance, nicknamed the Secret Avengers, were founded by Captain America in response to the Superhuman Registration Act, set up precisely for those who felt giving the government control over them was wrong, instead choosing to oppose superhuman registration.

name: Outriders
deck: Outriders are genetically engineered parasite-assassins that serve the Mad Titan Thanos.

name: Phantoms
deck: Phantoms (a.k.a. "Space Phantoms") are beings who become lost in Limbo and lose their identity. They then serve Immortus as his personal army of shape-shifting trouble-makers.

name: Phoenix Five
deck: Five members of the X-Men who each received a portion of the Phoenix Force after it was accidentally split by Iron Man during the battle between the X-Men and the Avengers over Hope.

name: Plodex
deck: Barbaric in nature and with the need to conquer, the Plodex exhausted their world resources

name: Plutonians
deck: Natives of Pluto.

name: Power Platoon
deck: Dakkamite militia that were the Stranger`s Prisoners

name: Priests of Pama
deck: The Priests of Pama are a pacifistic sect of the Kree that helped the Cotati flee from their planet and spread through the universe. They taught Mantis, Moondragon, Libra and several others how to use their powers.

name: Project PEGASUS
deck: Members of Project Potential Energy Groups/Alternate Sources/United States

name: Rajaks
deck: A green skinned alien race whose society is littered with space pirates.

name: Rangers
deck: A Texas based superhero group. The group was later incorperated by The 50 States Initiative as one of it's government sponsored teams

name: Rat Pack
deck: The Rat Pack is the name of three separate group of villains in the Marvel universe.

name: Reanimated Skeletons
deck: Are skeletons that are undead. Usually they are in armies or sometimes alone.

name: Red Guard
deck: The Red Guard is an elite team of SHIELD agents in the House of M universe, created when the Scarlet Witch re-built reality to fit her desires. Wolverine is their leader, but when he apparently goes rogue, the rest of the team is forced to hunt him down.

name: Rigellians
deck: An advanced race that likes to colonize other planets.

name: Robos
deck: Alkhema's robotic army modelled after Avengers.

name: Rock Trolls
deck: These evil beasts are powerful and brutish enemies of the Asgardians. Their strength and size has been a huge asset to their species against their enemies.

name: Roxxon
deck: A big petroleum corporation headed by Dario Agger. They make profits with unethical methods and are often involved in criminal activity.

name: Royal Inhuman Diplomatic Mission
deck: A generation of Inhumans to help and protect NuHumans.

name: S.H.I.E.L.D.
deck: A U.N. affiliated intelligence agency dealing primarily with terrorism and superhuman threats that was originally founded by the U.S. government.

name: S.T.A.R.S.
deck: The Superhuman Tactical Activities Response Squad was an organisation bent on bringing escaped super-human criminals to justice.

name: S.W.O.R.D.
deck: The Sentient Worlds Observation and Response Department was a sub-division of SHIELD that deals with extraterrestrial matters and is lead by Special Agent Abigail Brand. Recently, after becoming defunct, the organization was revived by the mutant nation of Krakoa.

name: Sakaarans
deck: The native races of the planet Sakaar.

name: Saturnian Hawk-Hounds
deck: Vicious flying hounds used by the Badoon to find non Badoon scents and attack

name: Secret Avengers
deck: The Secret Avengers are a black ops branch of the Avengers. Assembled by Steve Rogers in the Heroic Age. The team is now a highly secret branch of S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Secret Empire
deck: The Secret Empire is a subversive organization formed by a clandestine group to take control of the U.S. government. It has had varying agents and schemes but have been beaten by several heroes over the years.

name: Secret Warriors
deck: A group of teenagers and young adults with the potential to become powerful weapons against evil (or for it). Nick Fury kept a private set of names and gathered them to combat such groups as the Skrull Empire, HYDRA, HAMMER, and America itself.

name: Sentinel Squad O*N*E
deck: Following the Decimation of the mutant race, Sentinel Squad O*N*E were commanded by James Rhodes and tasked with policing mutants in the new climate.

name: Sentinels
deck: Advanced androids designed to hunt down and eliminate mutants.

name: Serpent Cartel
deck: A group of powerful entrepreneurs who combined their assets in service of Set.

name: Serpent Society
deck: The Serpent Society is an organization of snake-themed supervillains banded together by Sidewinder as he promised they would never be imprisoned, thanks to his power.

name: Shadows
deck: The Shadow people are a race of aliens who were marooned on Sakaar millennia ago. The Shadow People (or Old Strong) have an ability to tap into a planets energy and utilize it to boost their strength, speed, durability and give them Earth Manipulation abilities.

name: Shi'ar
deck: The Shi'ar are an alien race of avian descent and one of the most powerful empires in space.

name: Sinister Six
deck: The Sinister Six is the name of various teams assembled with the purpose of defeating Spider-Man or pursuing criminal endeavors. Formed and recurrently led by Doctor Octopus, subsequent iterations of the Sinister Six have also been led by Hobgoblin, Sandman, Green Goblin and currently Boomerang.

name: Skrulls
deck: "They called themselves Skrulls! But, by any name, they were a band of the most dangerous menaces Earth had ever faced! They are able to change their appearances at will!"

name: Sleepers
deck: Series of robots used by Red Skull.

name: Sneepers
deck: The Sneepers are an alien race of the Marvel Universe, depicted in the Watcher's tales.

name: Sons of The Serpent
deck: A white supremacist group with occult roots that have used various means to achieve their ends, including media manipulation, blackmail, and bio-warfare — all with the unifying theme of racism.

name: Sons Of The Tiger
deck: The Sons of the Tiger are a group of three martial artists who use mystical amulets to increase their skills and fight evil.

name: Spaceknights
deck: Metal-clad warriors from the golden galaxy of Galador, the Spaceknights traverse the cosmos hunting their eternal foes; the dreaded Dire Wraiths.

name: Split-Second Squad
deck: A team of minor Avengers villains. Named for the exact timing of their capers.

name: Squadron Sinister
deck: Enemy of the Avengers and Defenders

name: Squadron Supreme
deck: Squadron Supreme is Marvel's version of DC Comics' Justice League of America.

name: Starcore
deck: A bunch of eggheads up on a space station used primarily for scientific observation.

name: Starforce
deck: The Kree Starforce are a battalion of specially powered being united by the Kree military as the best of their empires meta-beings. Utilized on several missions to defend the aging home-world of Kree-Lar, and than after its destruction the new Empire.

name: Stark Industries
deck: Once a small company created by Howard Stark, Stark Industries has grown into one of the world's largest corporations and is the primary manufacturer of military weaponry for the United States.

name: Steel Skulls
deck: A team of mercinaries, led by the Grim Reaper

name: Stepford Cuckoos
deck: The Stepford Cuckoos are five powerful telepaths - cloned daughters of Emma Frost's - who can combine their telepathic abilities to create a much more powerful hive-mind. The Cuckoos are currently acting as psychic emissaries to the mutant nation & are residing at The White Palace in Krakoa with Emma Frost.

name: Stonians
deck: Alien gargoyle-like species.

name: Storm Giants
deck: A race of giants.

name: Strange Academy
deck: The Strange Academy is an education institute in New Orleans founded by Doctor Strange, to prepare the next generation of magic users to protect the world.

name: Super-Apes
deck: A trio of apes who were granted superpowers after being exposed to cosmic rays.

name: Super-Skrulls
deck: Those of the Skrull race who have been genetically reengineered to possess the attributes of other species, most notably the super-human population of Earth-616. Unlike regular skrulls, Super-Skrulls have to potential to mimic the powers, skills, knowledge and memories of others.

name: Symbiotes
deck: The Klyntar are an alien race that feeds on the emotions of its host. Also referred to as the Synoptic or the Symbian. They exist in a near liquid form.

name: Targoth Troops
deck: Slorenia soldiers

name: Teen Brigade
deck: The original Teen Brigade were a group of teenagers that used Radio Hams to help the Hulk and the Avengers during their early years. More recently, a new Teen Brigade, a team of superheroes, have surfaced acting on classified SHIELD intel.

name: The Avengers
deck: British agents fighting unorthodox foes.

name: The Carol Corps
deck: Various squads of female pilots associated with Carol Danvers

name: The Five
deck: The Five are a circuit of mutants whose powers, working in tandem, can resurrect deceased mutants. They are a pillar of Krakoan society and serve as a symbol of mutant ingenuity and resilience.

name: The Galactic Avenger Battalion
deck: The Galactic Avenger Battalion, once known as the peaceful Avengers Corps, was originally formed to protect The Kree during Operation: Galactic Storm.

name: The Garden
deck: The Garden is a group composed of beings that are all avatars of creation myths. Their purpose is to prepare worlds to become better worlds.

name: The Hex
deck: It is a group made up of six Eternals, a number sacred to the Eternals. They were created for large-scale war and destruction. It has never been specified whether they were created by the celestials or by Uranus, but it is known that they are part of the Arsenal of Uranus.

name: The Horde
deck: The Horde are the Locusts of The Universe and equal to The Celestials, their counterparts, in every respect. When The Dreaming Celestial awoke so too did The Horde, they are not aware of the fact however that their primary functions have been compromised by the Arishem and other Celestials.

name: The Infinites
deck: The Infinities are a group of three abstract beings who wield incalculable power. They used to travel the Multiverse realigning the energies of each Universe they traveled to in a way they considered harmonious.

name: The Initiative
deck: The Initiative is the program created, under the SHRA, to train those with powers and abilities. Individuals that pass have a chance of being assigned to one of the fifty officially sanctioned teams.

name: The Many-Angled Ones
deck: The Many-Angled Ones are a race of Eldritch Abominations that live in the spaces between realities. They are led by Shuma-Gorath, the Lord of Chaos and eldest of The Old Ones.

name: The Quiet Council of Krakoa
deck: The Quiet Council is the governing body of the mutant nation, Krakoa.

name: The Structure
deck: A vampire cult based out of New York City

name: The Thule Society
deck: The Thule Society is the latest incarnation of an ancient society of scientist mystics.

name: The Universal Church of Truth
deck: The Universal Church of Truth is the church of Adam Magus, Adam Warlock's evil self. They believe Magus to be a god and follow his religion extremely faithfully.

name: The Watchers
deck: The Watchers are some of the oldest beings in the universe. They remain perched throughout the universe using their advanced technology to record all events without interfering.

name: The Worthy
deck: The divine hammer-wielding generals of the Serpent.

name: Thunderbolts
deck: The Thunderbolts went through many evolutions: Baron Zemo's plan for world domination, a superhero team comprised of super-villains seeking redemption, Norman Osborn's personal hit squad, a government-sponsored prison reform project, and more. What they had in common was a roster that was always made of supervillains and anti-heroes willing to cross the lines other heroic teams wouldn't.

name: Thunderbolts Army
deck: During the Civil War, the Thunderbolts were tasked with apprehending various superhumans in violation of the SHRA and enlisted them into an army against the Grandmaster.

name: Time Variance Authority
deck: A society of far-flung future time-travelers that attempts to keep the time-stream in order.

name: Time-Keepers
deck: The Time Keepers are the guardians of the time reality, created short after the universe was born by He Who Remains.

name: Time-Twisters
deck: The Time-Twisters were the surviving beings of the last universe who were to inspire future beings on how to avoid the mistakes of the universe. They were flawed and supposedly wiped from existence by He Who Remains and replaced by the Time-Keepers.

name: Titanic Three
deck: Radioactive Man, Titanium Man and Crimson Dynamo joined forces in North Vietnam and allied themselves with the Viet Cong, allowing them free reign in North Vietnam without the meddling of superheroes.

name: Titans
deck: Godlike aliens (later retconned as a group of Eternals) who founded a colony on Saturn's Moon Titan, becoming a civilization run by the supercomputer ISAAC and producing Starfox, Mentor, and Thanos.

name: Triada Vertice
deck: A Spanish super hero comic created by Rafael Marín, Carlos Pacheco and Jesús Merino.

name: Triune Understanding
deck: A religious cult.

name: U-Foes
deck: Simon Utrecht and his compatriots attempt to recreate the historic flight of the Fantastic Four, with mixed results.

name: Ultimates
deck: Originally a group of supersoldiers recruited by Nick Fury as a means of defending the world and protecting America's best interests under the department of Homeland Security. The team at one point distanced themselves from the US government to deal with threats independently but have recently joined back up with S.H.I.E.L.D. Now they serve as the ultimate team to fight any and all disturbances in the Marvel Universe.

name: United Nations
deck: The United Nations is an international organisation, dedicated to facilitating world peace. It was brought into being to replace the failed League of Nations, which had similar aspirations but fell victim to internal squabbles.

name: United States Air Force
deck: The airborne branch of the United States Armed Forces.

name: United States Army
deck: The land-based branch of the United States Armed Forces.

name: United States Navy
deck: The naval warfare-based branch of the United States Armed Forces.

name: Utopia's Security Recon
deck: A new team formed as of Regenesis. Cyclops' main act of defense for Utopia and international purposes under Storm's leadership and jursidiction.

name: Vampires
deck: Powerful creatures of the night, neither dead nor living. They typically feed on blood, but what they need to survive can vary.

name: Vanna
deck: Air creatures. They can be part of the silent breeze, so that none can see or hear them.

name: Vietcong
deck: Communist political organization that fought against South Vietnam, America, and France in the Vietnam War.

name: Wakandan Army
deck: The military force of the great African nation known as Wakanda.

name: War Toys
deck: Alkhema's robot servants.

name: Warbound
deck: The Warbound are a small group of allies lead by the Hulk that toppled the empire of the evil Red King on Sakaar.

name: Warriors Three
deck: A trio of fierce and loyal Asgardian warriors and friends of Thor. Hogun the Grim, Fandral the Dashing and Volstagg the Lion of Asgard are the Warriors Three.

name: Winter Guard
deck: The Winter Guard is Russia's elite superhuman strikeforce.

name: Wrecking Crew
deck: The Wrecking Crew was a group of four criminals who were given godlike powers. They were occasional adversaries of Thor.

name: X-Club
deck: The fringe science team that Beast put together to reverse the effects of M-Day. Currently acts as the intelligence unit for Cyclops on Utopia, and is led by Dr. Nemesis.

name: X-Factor
deck: Originally a team comprising the original five X-Men, X-Factor was eventually turned a government task force. Jamie Madrox later took the name to found X-Factor Investigations and ultimately sold it to Serval Industries. Now, X-Factor Investigations was reformed on Krakoa.

name: X-Force
deck: When Cable reformed the New Mutants, he made them his soldiers. They became a mutant "black ops" team, assigned to kill not just the enemies of the X-Men, but of all mutantkind. Although this team eventually disbanded, the X-Force moniker has persisted in successive iterations of more and more aggressive X-teams.

name: X-Men
deck: The X-Men are a superhero team of mutants founded by Professor Charles Xavier. They are dedicated to helping fellow mutants and sworn to protect a world that fears and hates them.

name: Young Avengers
deck: A group of teenage superheroes with powers and abilities mirroring those of the Avengers, Young Avengers was formed by Iron Lad to defeat his future self, Kang. After the team disbanded, Kate Bishop later reformed the team with new costumes. A new team has now been formed by Loki.

name: Zenn-Lavians
deck: Inhabitants of the peaceful planet Zenn-La

name: Zodiac
deck: A Crime Organization based on Astrology.
